name: Corporate Action Standing Instruction General Information 1
definition: Provides information about the standing instruction.

InstructingPartyIdentification.name: Instructing Party Identification
InstructingPartyIdentification.definition: Identification of the instructing party, ie, the CSD client.

ClientStandingInstructionIdentification.name: Client Standing Instruction Identification
ClientStandingInstructionIdentification.definition: Reference of the standing instruction assigned by the client.

AccountDetails.name: Account Details
AccountDetails.definition: Provides information about the account to which the standing instruction can apply.

UnderlyingSecurity.name: Underlying Security
UnderlyingSecurity.definition: Identification of the underlying financial instrument, ie, the financial instrument affected by the corporate action event.
